listing.name: Galerians (Galerians Recompiled)
listing.summary: Register the completed Windows Galerians player generated by upstream from your own three USA discs. Keep preparation, disc selection, save-state migration and runtime replacement with upstream; this is a non-owning existing-copy route, not a managed build.

steps.title: Prepare the exact three owned discs upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete kit, components and a privately prepared player you are independently permitted to use for noncommercial purposes under the pinned framework terms. Supply your own Galerians USA CUE/BIN discs1/2/3, serials SLUS-00986, SLUS-01098 and SLUS-01099; keep every companion track and each CUE together, with all three discs in the same folder. Upstream identifies their dataTrack01 MD5s as217885a22fbb0f3092f8405ce42419ea,5bc6de661cb074cd5218ac0b9daecda2 and992e16e5164febd23c8242ede1fc0d8c. Those are data-track identifiers, not whole-set/CUE hashes or permission to acquire the discs. Disc1’s preparation config also specifies size695399376 and SHA1 f69e7299e5cea91a74e1e4c9893e6781d1227d1d; do not substitute another region or edition.

steps.title: Finish the supported private preparation before attachment
steps.instruction: The Windows release ZIP is a setup kit without generated game code. Complete its upstream wizard with Disc1 and Generate & rebuild outside Portcove, using its supplied OpenBIOS and supported tools. The source-build recipe additionally applies this title’s three patches and uses --force-emitters; follow the matching upstream recipe instead of mixing framework revisions. Preserve all three originals separately. Generation starts from Disc1; the one resulting program uses the later discs as data. Reachable discovery retains interpreter fallback for unreached code; this is not an all-code-ahead-of-time guarantee.

steps.title: Select the completed native game product
steps.instruction: Select the successful build-release/Galerians_Recompiled.exe product, use its complete build-release directory as working directory and leave arguments empty. Keep matching bios/, mods/, assets, game.toml and runtime companions and the selected own disc paths. This completed game-dispatch product keeps the normal launcher/game in-process. Do not register the root setup host, scripts, toolchain or unfinished output: a Windows setup host can forward to another process and exit. Saving launch details and requesting Play are separate actions requiring your consent.

steps.title: Preserve all effective settings, cards and original roots
steps.instruction: Before startup, back up the complete kit and creating player directory, settings.toml, disc/BIOS sidecars, saves/ with card1.mcd/card2.mcd, game options/save states, mods/, logs/reports/cache/captures and every actual custom/external root. Existing explicit card paths, --memcard-dir or PSX_OVERLAY_CAPTURE_ROOT remain separate choices; do not merge them. Startup can remove an older settings.toml.bad and rename malformed settings.toml there, so preserve both outside the installation before launching. No cross-disc-variant, BIOS, build or mod save compatibility is promised.

steps.title: Keep legacy state migration and disc selection explicit
steps.instruction: Upstream’s first legacy-state migration can move loose state_*.pst files into openbios/ or scph1001/ subfolders and writes .pst_bios_isolated even when some files are skipped. Preserve the old and new save folders and marker together in separate pre-start backups; no automatic retry or cross-BIOS compatibility is promised. Use the native player’s own Disc Selection/Change disc controls for later owned CUEs and retain every source disc; Portcove does not import saves, switch discs or migrate profiles.

steps.title: Leave rebuilds, mods and runtime replacement with upstream
steps.instruction: Upstream/user owns generation, rebuilding, updates, recovery and save writes. Builds stage their mod catalog and can clear/replace mods/packages before copying title packages; back up custom mods and the complete working output outside all build/staging destinations before rebuilding. Optional Generate & rebuild/PGO/restart actions can create successors and are outside this tracked-player route. Close all actual games/helpers/successors before maintenance or another attachment, then review/relink changed bytes. Removing registration preserves every external file; no Core-managed update, rollback, backup, migration or deletion is offered.

steps.title: Retain title-specific requirements and limitations
steps.instruction: Keep applicable PolyForm Noncommercial framework, separate MIT launcher/OpenBIOS and other component notices; these do not grant original-game redistribution rights. The inspected release is early. Upstream reports early gameplay but has not established play beyond the first room, save/load, mid-game disc changes, a full playthrough or PGO. Those limits remain; optional cheats, controllers and graphics features are not compatibility promises. Retain known-working copies when updating.

warnings: The release is a setup kit; attach the completed private native product. Keep all three owned discs and separate backups before legacy-state migration or rebuilding. Saving/loading and mid-game disc changes remain upstream-unverified beyond the reported early test scope.
